contentPattern.structure: circular avatar + name (heading) + role/skills line + row of 3 social-media icon links

suitableFor: team / staff / contributor / people directory grids
profile cards with a circular avatar, name, role and social links
'meet the team' or 'our guides' style sections
centered person cards with a row of social-media icon buttons
notSuitableFor: article/adventure teaser grids with a landscape image on top (use cards-article)
members-only / locked teaser pairs with image-below-content (use cards-secure)

usage.note: Created for the WKND About Us page 'Our Contributors' (4-up) and 'WKND Guides' (3-up) profile grids. Each source card is a contributor Experience Fragment (circular avatar + h3 name + h5 role + three social-media icon links). Based on the local DA cards conventions: imports ONLY from ../../scripts/aem.js (no moveInstrumentation / fetchPlaceholders / scripts.js). Reuses the footer's inline social SVGs so icon links render consistently. The 3-up WKND Guides grid is a .cards-team.guides modifier on the same variant (a column-count CSS tweak, not a separate block).
